vis_one_image: visualize object detection results with bounding boxes, masks, and keypoints and save to a PDF file
vis_one_image_opencv: construct a numpy array with detection boxes, segmentation masks, and keypoints visualized using OpenCV
vis_mask: overlay a colored binary segmentation mask onto an image with optional white border outline
vis_keypoints: draw COCO-style human pose keypoints and skeleton connections on an image using OpenCV
convert_from_cls_format: flatten per-class detection boxes, segmentation masks, and keypoints into consolidated numpy arrays
